_note: DRAFT passages for The Völva to edit, in the register's manner. The reading uses these beside lib/corpus.json: planets, signs in both zodiacs, the 24 runes, the centres, the four aims of the padas, and where each mansion works best. Change any line here and every reading changes with it.

FRAMES.sidereal: Sidereal positions are measured against the fixed stars. They describe the karma you arrived with and the reality that forms around you: what happens, what is handed to you, what the world keeps returning. Read them as the terrain.
FRAMES.tropical: Tropical positions are measured against the seasons, the Earth's own turning. They describe how you experience that terrain from inside: what it feels like, how you meet it, the weather of your inner life. Read them as the walking.
FRAMES.both: Every planet below is read twice. First where it stands among the stars, which is what it brings into your life. Then where it stands in the seasons, which is how you live with it. When the two agree, the planet is simple to work. When they differ, you feel one thing while living another, and the reading names both so you can stop arguing with either.

Sun.governs: Purpose, vitality, the father and every authority you answer to.
Sun.sid: Where your life asks you to stand in your own light, and where recognition comes from or is withheld.
Sun.trop: How you feel most yourself, and what makes you feel alive enough to keep going.
Sun.light: Steady warmth that lets others orient.
Sun.shadow: Needing to be seen to feel real.
Sun.lends: purpose, visibility and the will to be seen

Moon.governs: Mind, mood, the mother, nourishment and memory.
Moon.sid: The emotional conditions you keep finding yourself in, and the people who mother you or need mothering.
Moon.trop: How your feelings move: their speed, their tides, what soothes them.
Moon.lends: feeling, responsiveness and the need to nourish

Mercury.governs: Thought, speech, trade, learning and the hands.
Mercury.sid: The kind of work your mind is given, the deals and messages that shape your fortunes.
Mercury.trop: How you think in the moment: the pace of your words and how you take in what you hear.
Mercury.light: Precise naming that makes things workable.
Mercury.shadow: Clever talk that avoids the point.
Mercury.lends: intelligence, skill and the urge to name and trade

Venus.governs: Love, beauty, pleasure, money and agreements.
Venus.sid: The partnerships, comforts and resources that come to you, and what they cost.
Venus.trop: What you find beautiful, how you like to be loved, what pleasure feels like in your body.
Venus.light: Grace that makes people want to stay.
Venus.lends: grace, pleasure and the power to attract

Mars.governs: Will, courage, conflict, the body's force and siblings.
Mars.sid: The fights you are handed, the work that demands strength, the places you must defend.
Mars.trop: How anger and desire move through you, and how you act when you want something.
Mars.light: Clean action at the right moment.
Mars.shadow: Force spent on the wrong target.
Mars.lends: drive, courage and the readiness to fight

Jupiter.governs: Wisdom, teachers, children, faith and growth.
Jupiter.sid: Where grace arrives in your life, the teachers who find you, and what multiplies when you tend it.
Jupiter.trop: How you hope, what you believe in, and how generous you feel.
Jupiter.lends: wisdom, faith and the power to grow things

Saturn.governs: Time, duty, limits, work and old karma.
Saturn.sid: Where life is slow, where you are tested, and where effort builds something that lasts.
Saturn.trop: How you feel about responsibility, fear and the passage of time.
Saturn.lends: patience, weight and the discipline to endure

Uranus.governs: Awakening, disruption and the future arriving early.
Uranus.sid: Where your life breaks pattern without asking, and what you are made to reinvent.
Uranus.trop: How you feel about freedom and where you itch to break the mould.

Neptune.governs: Dream, devotion, dissolution and the unseen.
Neptune.sid: Where your life blurs, where you are asked to surrender, and where inspiration enters.
Neptune.trop: How you dream, long and escape, and how porous you feel.

Pluto.governs: Power, death and rebirth, what is buried.
Pluto.sid: Where your life demands total change and hands you power you must learn to hold.
Pluto.trop: How you feel intensity, control and the pull to go to the bottom of things.

Rahu.governs: Appetite, the new, the foreign, the direction of growth.
Rahu.sid: Where your life pulls you toward the unfamiliar and the more, and what you are here to learn by hunger.
Rahu.trop: What you crave and how that craving feels: urgent, fascinating, never quite enough.
Rahu.light: Courage to go where your line has never been.
Rahu.shadow: Hunger that eats the meal and stays hungry.
Rahu.lends: hunger, amplification and the pull toward the new

Ketu.governs: Release, past mastery, spirit and the cut.
Ketu.sid: What you already know from before, where life strips things away, and where you are free.
Ketu.trop: Where you feel detached, where nothing quite satisfies, and where peace comes easiest.
Ketu.lends: detachment, instinct and mastery carried from before

SIGNS.karma: a life that hands you beginnings and asks you to go first
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as impulse: quick, hot, now

SIGNS.karma: a life that tests what you keep and whether it is worth keeping
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as appetite and steadiness: slow, sensory, loyal

SIGNS.karma: a life of messages, siblings, crossings and two of everything
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as curiosity: restless, quick, talkative

SIGNS.karma: a life organised around home, family and who feeds whom
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as feeling first: protective, tidal, remembering

SIGNS.karma: a life that puts you at the centre and asks what you will do there
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as pride and warmth: generous, dramatic, wanting to shine

SIGNS.karma: a life of service, repair and work that must be done well
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as discernment: careful, useful, quick to see the flaw

SIGNS.karma: a life shaped by partners, trade and the balance between people
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as relation: fair-minded, graceful, weighing everything

SIGNS.karma: a life of depths, shared resources, crisis and renewal
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as intensity: private, loyal, all or nothing

SIGNS.karma: a life of teachers, travel, law and the search for meaning
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as faith and range: frank, roaming, aiming high

SIGNS.karma: a life of duty, rank, long climbs and earned authority
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as ambition and restraint: dry, patient, responsible

SIGNS.karma: a life tied to groups, networks, causes and the future
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as detachment and vision: principled, unusual, cool

SIGNS.karma: a life of surrender, service, retreat and the unseen
SIGNS.felt: you experience it as merging: dreamy, porous, compassionate

HOUSE_LIFE: your body, your name and how you arrive in a room
money, food, family and the voice
effort, skill, siblings, short journeys and courage
creativity, children, romance, past merit and intelligence
daily work, health, service, debts and opponents
marriage, partners, contracts and the public
crisis, inheritance, other people's money, the occult and transformation
teachers, father, faith, long journeys and luck
career, reputation, authority and what you are known for
gains, friends, networks and fulfilled wishes
loss, solitude, foreign lands, sleep, spiritual release

Fehu.means: Moveable wealth, energy that must circulate.
Fehu.light: Abundance kept moving: earning, giving, investing.
Fehu.shadow: Hoarding, or wealth that burns through you.
Fehu.call: Let what comes to you move on.

Uruz.means: Raw strength, health, the wild ox.
Uruz.light: Vitality, endurance, a body you can trust.
Uruz.shadow: Brute force, or strength left unused.

Thurisaz.means: The thorn, defence, the force that protects.

Ansuz.light: Words that carry truth and teach.

Raidho.means: The road, the ride, right rhythm.
Raidho.light: Travel and effort in good order.
Raidho.call: Keep the pace that gets you there.

Kenaz.means: The torch, craft, knowledge made visible.
Kenaz.shadow: Burning out, or a lit room you hide in.
Kenaz.call: Bring your craft to the light.

Gebo.means: The gift, exchange, the bond it makes.
Gebo.call: Give so that both are freer.

Wunjo.call: Make the joy, don't wait for it.

Hagalaz.means: Hail, disruption that clears the field.
Hagalaz.light: Crisis that resets what was stuck.

Nauthiz.means: Need, friction, the fire made by rubbing.

Eihwaz.means: The yew, the axis between life and death.
Eihwaz.call: Hold the axis through the turn.

Perthro.means: The lot-cup, fate, chance and mystery.

Algiz.means: The elk, protection, the sacred guard.
Algiz.call: Guard what is sacred, open the rest.

Tiwaz.means: The god of justice, the oath.
Tiwaz.light: Honour, fair fight, sacrifice for right.

Mannaz.shadow: Isolation or losing yourself in the crowd.

Dagaz.shadow: Waiting for a dawn you won't walk toward.

Othala.call: Keep what serves, release the rest.

Head.does: Pressure to know, inspiration, the questions.
Head.body: Crown of the head; the pineal.
Head.defined: You carry steady mental pressure of your own. Ideas arrive on schedule; they settle and sort themselves before they ask for action.
Head.open: Other people's questions fill your head. Your wisdom shows in sensing which questions matter, and which can simply pass through.

Ajna.body: The brow, the eyes, the mind.
Ajna.defined: You think in a fixed, reliable way. Your opinions are consistent, and sit easily beside other people's.
Ajna.open: You can see many sides. Your strength is not having to be certain.

Throat.defined: Your voice has a consistent way of coming out. It lands most fully when the moment opens for it.
Throat.open: You speak in many voices. Your words carry furthest when the room has already turned toward you.

G.body: The heart region and liver; the magnetic centre of the chest.
G.defined: You have a fixed sense of who you are and where you are going. Others orient around you.
G.open: Your direction comes from your surroundings. The right place and the right people are your compass.

Heart.body: The physical heart, stomach, gall bladder.
Heart.defined: You have reliable willpower. It runs in bursts: a few promises held well, then a natural ebb after effort.
Heart.open: You have nothing to prove. Worth here is not earned through promises; it is already in place.

Spleen.body: The spleen and lymph; the immune system.
Spleen.defined: Your instincts speak once, in the moment. Your body knows, quietly and quickly.
Spleen.open: You sense other people's health and fear. What is no longer good for you loosens its hold over time.

Solar.body: Solar plexus; kidneys, pancreas, the nervous system.
Solar.defined: You run on an emotional wave. Clarity comes over time, settling after the high and low have passed.
Solar.open: You amplify other people's feelings. Not every emotion in you is yours.

Sacral.body: The sacrum, ovaries and testes; the gut's yes and no.
Sacral.defined: You have sustainable energy for what you love. Your gut answers before your mind does.
Sacral.open: You borrow energy from others. It runs high in company and drains fast when it is gone.

Root.body: The adrenals and the base of the spine.
Root.defined: You handle pressure in a steady rhythm. It moves you to begin rather than to rush.
Root.open: You feel other people's urgency. The pressure passes through you, and you can act well with it present.

AIMS.says: This pada works through purpose and right action. Energy here is fed by meaning: it flows when you are doing what is yours to do.
This pada works through resources and building. Energy here is fed by results: it flows when effort becomes something real you can hold.
This pada works through desire and relationship. Energy here is fed by connection and pleasure: it flows when you want what you are doing.
This pada works through release. Energy here is fed by letting go: it flows when you stop holding on.

GANA.Deva: You do best in cultures that value kindness, ideals and refinement: places of learning, healing, art or devotion, with gentle manners and shared values.
GANA.Manushya: You do best in human-scale, practical cultures: places of trade, family, community and getting things done, where people are judged by what they contribute.
GANA.Rakshasa: You do best in intense, independent cultures: places with edge, risk or depth, where directness is respected and nobody needs you to be nice.

ELEMENTS.fire: Places with light, movement and challenge: warm climates, open spaces, competitive or pioneering workplaces.
ELEMENTS.earth: Places with structure and substance: land, gardens, workshops, established institutions, cities that build things.
ELEMENTS.air: Places with exchange and ideas: cities, crossroads, media, networks, anywhere people meet and talk.
ELEMENTS.water: Places near water or with emotional depth: coasts, sanctuaries, healing spaces, close-knit and private settings.

SETTING: Emergency rooms, start-ups, first responders, anywhere speed saves something.
Places of birth and death, transformation, creative studios with deadlines, work with high stakes.
Kitchens, forges, editing rooms, anywhere things are cut, refined and purified.
Gardens, farms, beauty, food and comfort businesses, settled communities with pleasure in them.
Research, travel, search and discovery, roles that let you keep looking.
Labs, crisis work, technology, storms of change, places that need someone who can bear the hard truth.
Homes, schools, renovation, second chances, anywhere things are restored and returned.
Teaching, caregiving, nourishing institutions, faith communities, the steady keepers.
Psychology, medicine, strategy, secrets, anywhere you have to read what lies under the surface.
Lineage, leadership, heritage institutions, ancestral work, places with ceremony and rank.
Hospitality, the arts, celebration, rest and pleasure trades.
Contracts, partnership, patronage, organisations that bind people in fair agreements.
Crafts, handwork, healing hands, comedy and skill trades.
Design, architecture, fashion, jewellery, anywhere beauty is built.
Independent trade, travel, wind-blown work, freelance, diplomacy.
Goal-driven organisations, campaigns, competition, anywhere a target must be reached.
Friendship networks, devotional groups, organisations that run on loyalty across distance.
Leadership in hard places, protection, senior roles that carry responsibility for others.
Root-level research, deconstruction, investigation, ecology, anywhere things are pulled up to see what is underneath.
Persuasion, purification, water and cleansing trades, advocacy.
Long projects, institutions, law, anywhere an undefeatable victory takes time.
Listening professions, teaching, media, learning and oral tradition.
Music, rhythm, wealth, collective celebration and performance.
Healing, research, secrecy, technology, hundred-cure work done alone.
Fierce causes, reform, ritual, intense transformation work.
Depths, counselling, long retreats, deep-water wisdom and patient institutions.
Travel, safe passage, care for animals, endings done kindly, completing work.

DIGNITY.exalted: It stands exalted here, at its strongest: what it gives comes easily and goes far. Your work is not to coast on it.
DIGNITY.root: It stands in its root sign, the stretch of its home where it works most purely as itself: steady, purposeful, and on its own business.
DIGNITY.own: It stands in its own sign, at home: it acts as itself, reliably. Lean on it.
DIGNITY.debilitated: It stands in its fall, at its weakest: what it governs comes slowly and costs effort. That effort, made honestly, becomes your mastery here.

AGREE.same: Both zodiacs put it in {sign}. What happens and how it feels are the same thing: this planet is straightforward for you.
AGREE.element: The stars put it in {sid}, the seasons in {trop}. Both are {element}, so the life and the feeling pull the same way, in different keys.
AGREE.differ: The stars put it in {sid} ({e1}); the seasons put it in {trop} ({e2}). You live in {e1} circumstances with {e2} in your temperament. When it feels wrong, check which of the two you are listening to.

WEAVE.self: Its star is ruled by this planet itself, so it answers to no one: it runs on its own fuel and is one of the anchors of your chart.
WEAVE.hub: {b} rules the stars of {n} of your planets. It is the hub of your chart: whatever state your {b} is in, much of your life is in too. Tend it first.
WEAVE.intro: No planet works alone. Each one stands in a star, and every star is ruled by a planet. Wherever that ruling planet sits in your chart, it lends its energy to everything standing in its star. Below, each planet's line of supply is traced.
